note: P0 draft of the world-delta vocabulary (Runtime V4 plan §5.1, §5.3, §5.5). Spike data, not product code: P3 moves the final vocabulary to content/deltas.json. One source for the inline block instruction (variant B), the recovery extractor (variant A and B's recovery), the JSON schema and the S2/S3 checks. Deltas report only outer world changes, in story order; none can express a decision of Alaric's.
rules: Report only what THIS reply establishes, in the order it happens (seq 1, 2, 3 …). Invent nothing.
Alaric's own decisions are in PLAYER ACTIONS and already booked by the engine; never report them as deltas (no payment, purchase, acceptance, turn-in, pick-up of his).
If the reply has Alaric decide something PLAYER ACTIONS does not list, report it only as overreach.
Answer every key of expected; each key asks about the PLAYER ACTION with the same number.
Known places, people, quests and objects by their id; a new place as {"new": {"name", "kind", "parent"}} (parent: a place id or one more {"new": …}).
Prices and coin are integers in copper (1 silver = 10 copper). The Guild's contract payout and the registration fee are the engine's; never report them.
Official Guild contracts come only from the engine's BOARD; never report a new one (if the reply shows one the BOARD lacks: overreach guild_listing).
